name: InputGroup
description: Composite input shell with flush left/right addons (icons, units, buttons) behind one outer outline; the nested field sheds its own border so the group reads as a single control.
designIntent: Search fields, URL/unit inputs, and inline actions need affixes that sit flush inside the field. InputGroup owns the combined border and focus ring (the outline doubles as the affordance) while addons stay visually part of the field: ghost addons keep the group background, muted addons paint a light gray, and nested inputs are stripped of their own chrome via descendant selectors.

props.name: side
props.description: Edge the addon hugs (flush against the group outline).

props.name: variant
props.description: Addon surface: ghost keeps the group background, muted paints a light gray.

examples.title: URL field with unit affixes
examples.description: Muted affixes carry the fixed parts of the value; only the middle is editable.

examples.title: Search with icon and action button
examples.code:
<InputGroup>
  <InputGroupAddon side="left" aria-hidden="true"><SearchIcon size={16} /></InputGroupAddon>
  <Input aria-label="Search" placeholder="Search issues…" />
  <InputGroupAddon side="right" variant="muted">
    <Button size="sm" variant="ghost">Go</Button>
  </InputGroupAddon>
</InputGroup>
examples.description: Leading icon is decorative; the trailing button is the pseudo action indicator.

examples.title: Numeric input with currency suffix
examples.description: The unit sits flush right; the outline communicates editability.

antiPatterns.title: Don't give nested inputs their own border
antiPatterns.explanation: The group's outer border is the control outline. Inner borders create double lines and break the flush-addon look — strip them with the group (built in) or avoid nesting a bordered Input.

antiPatterns.title: Don't nest interactive elements without labels
antiPatterns.explanation: Addon buttons live inside the field's focus-within region; they still need accessible names and must not steal the field's label association.

accessibility.implementation: Focus ring renders on the group via focus-within; nested inputs keep keyboard focus and their label association (htmlFor/id still targets the input)
accessibility.userRequirements: Label the INPUT (FormField/Input aria-label), not the group

accessibility.implementation: Purely decorative icons/text in addons should carry aria-hidden or the input's aria-label should include the unit
accessibility.userRequirements: Mark decorative addons aria-hidden; name units the field's accessible name when they change meaning (e.g. aria-label="Amount in PLN")

accessibility.implementation: Nested input's disabled styling applies; addons are independent — disable buttons inside them yourself
accessibility.userRequirements: Disable addon buttons when the field is disabled

guidelines: Use the same casing the user would type
Prefer icons for actions, text for value parts

compositionRules.relationship: The nested field is the editable region; InputGroup strips its border/ring automatically
Wrap the whole group when it needs a persistent label or error
Buttons inside addons are the action affordance — ghost/variant='ghost' keeps the flush look
